title: The marked-point stabilizer is open and its index is the cardinality of the geometric fibre.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite etale morphism of connected schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Omega$ an algebraically closed field, and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point. Set $t=f\circ s$, let $P=(X\xrightarrow{f}Y)$ be its finite etale cover [def-galois-categories], and let $a=s\in F_t(P)$ for the geometric fibre functor [def-galois-fibre-functor]. Let $G_X,G_Y$ be compact topological fundamental-group models of $F_s,F_t$, with their natural continuous fibre actions, and put $U=\operatorname{Stab}_{G_Y}(a)$. Then $U$ is open in $G_Y$ and $[G_Y:U]=\#F_t(P)$.

lean.statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupMap_stabilizer_open_and_index
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace X] [ConnectedSpace Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Etale f]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (GX GY : Type u) [Group GX] [TopologicalSpace GX] [IsTopologicalGroup GX]
    [CompactSpace GX] [∀ Q, MulAction GX ((fiber s).obj Q)]
    [IsFundamentalGroup (fiber s) GX]
    [Group GY] [TopologicalSpace GY] [IsTopologicalGroup GY] [CompactSpace GY]
    [∀ P, MulAction GY ((fiber (s ≫ f)).obj P)]
    [IsFundamentalGroup (fiber (s ≫ f)) GY] :
    let P : Y.FiniteEtale := ⟨Etale.mk f, inferInstanceAs (IsFinite f)⟩
    let a : (fiber (s ≫ f)).obj P := fiberMk (s ≫ f) P s rfl
    let U := MulAction.stabilizer GY a
    IsOpen (U : Set GY) ∧ U.index = Nat.card ((fiber (s ≫ f)).obj P)
